newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso dips 30 centavos against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso dips 30 centavos against dollar.

text.p: Colombia's peso dipped a marginal 30 centavos to 1,106.4 against the dollar on Monday, interbank traders said.
Dealers said some petro-dollars were entering the market but that there was little speculative trading. They said they expected the rate to remain stable Tuesday.
The peso opened at 1,107.7 and traded between an intraday high of 1,106.2 and a low of 1,109. Dealers reported 288 trades worth $153 million.
